documents.title: What is a receivable?
documents.question: What does receivable mean?
documents.answer: A receivable is money your business expects to receive from customers for goods or services provided.

documents.title: What is a payable?
documents.question: What does payable mean?
documents.answer: A payable is money your business owes to suppliers or other parties.

documents.title: How do I check customer balances?
documents.question: How can I see how much my customers owe me?
documents.answer: Check the customer balance or receivables section in your account. The exact steps may depend on your HisabDo app version.

documents.title: What is cash flow?
documents.question: Explain cash flow for my business.
documents.answer: Cash flow describes money moving into and out of a business during a period. Cash received is an inflow, and money paid out is an outflow.

documents.title: How do I record a customer payment?
documents.question: My customer paid me. How should I record the payment?
documents.answer: Record the payment using the appropriate payment or transaction workflow in your accounting system. Confirm the existing receivable and payment details before saving to avoid duplicate records.

documents.title: What money do customers owe my business?
documents.question: What money do customers still owe my business? What money is still outstanding? Mere customers ke paas mera kitna paisa baqi hai?
documents.answer: Money customers owe your business is called accounts receivable. It is the amount your business expects to collect from customers for goods or services provided.
